mapper.select: SELECT paid_day, plan_code, plan_name, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, SUM(amount_minor) AS amount_minor, currency FROM ( SELECT (r.paid_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date AS paid_day, r.plan_code, r.plan_name, r.amount_minor, r.currency FROM recharge_record r WHERE r.paid_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND r.paid_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR r.user_id = #{userId}) ) local_payment GROUP BY paid_day, plan_code, plan_name, currency ORDER BY paid_day, plan_code, currency
